Present pacing follows the refresh rate of the screen the window is on (integer-fraction tier, ported from upstream d2r-mobile 44a6770): the game window was on a 30 Hz TV, where fixed-60 pacing shows each frame half a refresh and the system rounds to two → 33 ms frames, every frame counted dropped, perceived as flicker; front_mac.m reports the screen and re-reads on screen change
shaders: iterate with the movie YUV->RGB conversion shaders (vs 85f721d0fe44a1e9, ps 2bf5fc9ac9cc0814 / b0aa1e941f09982a); chain ea9c3b90985d
patch_nso: revert the three Blade movie cuts (player Tick ret, Stop nop in close, close track walk) now that the movie protocol is implemented

hle_movie: real movie:: playback for the generic host (Blade / UE4 SwitchMediaPlayer): Extractor = AVFoundation sample cursor (time-interleaved tokens, SeekTo for loops), Decoder = token -> NV12 / PCM16 via a guest worker thread with hardware-like back pressure, MediaData = host dictionary; protocol reversed into the file header; D2R empty playback kept under !DM_GENERIC_HOST; hle_blade.c MediaData placeholders removed
movie_av: AVFoundation demux / decode for cutscene mp4 (sample table scan, NV12 / PCM16 output); dm_fs_host_path for host-side opens of rom: paths

Mac app: present via the self-driven drawable path by default (DM_PRESENT_LINK=0); the display-link callback stalls for whole seconds under other system load and the stall fallbacks are the flicker the player saw — same build, same session A/B: near zero flicker on the self-driven path
mac_app_blade.sh: brace ${APP} before the full-width parenthesis (a C-locale shell parsed the UTF-8 bytes into the variable name and failed under set -u)
